input.business_intent: What are the top performing products of last quarter?

args.sql_query:
-- First, identify the latest quarter in the dataset
SELECT MAX(quarter_period) as latest_quarter
FROM top_performing_products

-- Get distinct quarters to understand data coverage
SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', quarter_period) as quarter
FROM top_performing_products
ORDER BY quarter DESC

-- Check the actual dates in quarter_period
SELECT DISTINCT quarter_period
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY quarter_period DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Top performing products by revenue in Q1 2024 (last quarter)
SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_revenue) as total_revenue,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_quantity_sold,
    AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_unit_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_segment) as customer_segments_served,
    COUNT(DISTINCT region) as regions_served
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 15

-- Check data distribution by product in March 2024
SELECT 
    product_name,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    MIN(total_revenue) as min_revenue,
    MAX(total_revenue) as max_revenue,
    SUM(total_revenue) as total_revenue
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY product_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 20

-- More detailed analysis with variance
SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_revenue) as total_revenue,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_quantity_sold,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_unit_price), 2) as avg_unit_price,
    COUNT(*) as total_records,
    ROUND(STDDEV(total_revenue), 2) as revenue_stddev,
    ROUND(MAX(total_revenue), 2) as max_single_record_revenue
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 25

-- Top products by customer segment for Q1 2024
SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    customer_segment,
    SUM(total_revenue) as segment_revenue,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as segment_quantity
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY product_name, category, customer_segment
ORDER BY segment_revenue DESC
LIMIT 30

-- Top 10 products by total revenue in Q1 2024, ordered by volume and price
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_revenue) DESC) as rank,
    product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_revenue) as total_revenue,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_quantity_sold,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_unit_price), 2) as avg_unit_price,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) / SUM(total_quantity_sold), 2) as revenue_per_unit
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Category performance breakdown
SELECT 
    category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_name) as product_count,
    SUM(total_revenue) as category_revenue,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as category_quantity,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_unit_price), 2) as avg_unit_price
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category_revenue DESC

-- Top products ranked by revenue with category mix
SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_revenue) as total_revenue,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_quantity_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) / SUM(total_quantity_sold), 2) as revenue_per_unit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_segment) as segments
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 20

-- Performance by region and customer segment
SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    region,
    customer_segment,
    SUM(total_revenue) as regional_revenue,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as regional_quantity
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY product_name, category, region, customer_segment
ORDER BY regional_revenue DESC
LIMIT 30

-- Summary by customer segment for all products
SELECT 
    customer_segment,
    SUM(total_revenue) as segment_revenue,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as segment_quantity,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_unit_price), 2) as avg_unit_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_name) as product_variety
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY segment_revenue DESC

-- Final comprehensive top products ranking
SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_revenue) as total_revenue,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_quantity_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) / SUM(total_quantity_sold), 2) as revenue_per_unit
FROM top_performing_products
WHERE quarter_period >= '2024-03-01' AND quarter_period <= '2024-03-31'
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
